text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I ran way too much and now my legs feel like a couple of logs…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guess it's time to call it a day, right? Well, nice work out there.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hi there, Sei! You done with training for today?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep, sure am. How about you, Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I was thinking about doing a little more. There's this technique I just can't get down.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Don't push yourself too hard. You won't get any better if you just throw yourself at it without thinking.
choice_data_list: Why don't you do some running together?
True. It's important to take good care of your body.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, I couldn't ask that. Sei was just about to go home…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Fine, guess I really should. You are my friend after all, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yaaay, awesome! Thanks, Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, just let me take a tiny break before we—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Sei! Let's get a move on!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: J-just a mo—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty! Here we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, let go! I'm not gonna run off, y'know! Uh, I mean, I am gonna run, but with you, not away!
And so, the two train together right up until curfew.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep. I think it's about time we called it a night.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The next race is coming up soon, so… I guess you're right. Let's end it here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! We can head home together, Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sure. Not like I've got anything else going on.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay! ♪ Let's get some food on the way! I was thinking some place with a big eating challenge…
Growl…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, my stomache can't say no to that. Go ahead and take me to your favorite spot.
After stopping by somewhere to eat, Seiun Sky and Special Week head home.
